sentences.text: The Republic of Ingushetia -LRB- -LSB- Респу́блика Ингуше́тия , Respublika Ingushetiya , rʲɪˈspublʲɪkə ɪnɡʊˈʂetʲɪjə -RSB- Гӏалгӏай Мохк , -RRB- , also referred to as simply Ingushetia , is a federal subject of Russia -LRB- a republic -RRB- , located in the North Caucasus region .	North Caucasus	North Caucasus	federal subject	federal subjects of Russia	republic	republics of Russia
Its capital is the town of Magas .	Magas	Magas	capital	capital city	town	types of inhabited localities in Russia

With its 3,000 square km , in terms of area , the republic is the smallest of Russia 's federal subjects except for the federal cities .	republic	republics of Russia	federal cities	federal cities of Russia

It was established on June 4 , 1992 after the Chechen-Ingush Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic was split in two .	Ingush	Ingush people	Chechen-Ingush Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic	Chechen-Ingush Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic
The republic is home to the indigenous Ingush , a people of Vainakh ancestry .	Ingush	Ingush people	republic	republics of Russia	Vainakh	Vainakh
As of the 2010 Census , its population was 412,529 .	2010 Census	Russian Census (2010)
Ingushetia is one of Russia 's poorest and most unstable regions .

The military conflict in neighboring Chechnya has occasionally spilled into Ingushetia , and the republic has been destabilized by corruption , a number of high-profile crimes -LRB- including kidnapping and murder of civilians by government security forces -RRB- , anti-government protests , attacks on soldiers and officers , Russian military excesses and a deteriorating human rights situation .	republic	republics of Russia	military conflict	insurgency in the North Caucasus	Chechnya	Chechnya
